audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all five clinic event records: Maru’s dropped sample and truth branch, Harvey’s annual checkup, his radio and aviation scene, and emergency surgery. Every line, embedded question, response option, conditional branch, radio call sign, medical meaning, and character voice was reviewed in full event context with canonical Maru, Harvey, farm, and clinic terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, friendship changes, response IDs, coordinates, quantities, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotion markers, sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
